messages:
Eli: FYI noticed small but consistent double-charges on resumed streaming sessions after the routing rollout.
Rhea: saw that too. traces show resume accepted (204) but quota service records a new session + a resume in the same window.
Jon: any repro steps? looks like header loss in the proxy retry path could break idempotency and force a fresh auth.
Eli: simple repro: open SSE -> kill connection -> client posts resume with X-Resume-Token -> proxy retries and sometimes drops header -> runtime accepts but quota sees two distinct sessions. logs:
Eli: ```
Client -> POST /v1/stream/resume
  X-Resume-Token: rt-867
Proxy(retry) -> POST /v1/stream/resume  # header missing here
Runtime -> 204 resume accepted
Quota -> increment tokens for token-A
Quota -> increment tokens for token-B
```
Rhea: Router: we rotated sticky routing TTL to 12s yesterday (canary). If header gets stripped, route selection can flip, producing a new auth flow.
Router: rollout note: sticky-ttl=12s in canary, fallback routing allowed.
Jon: short-term action: add X-Resume-Token to proxy retry header whitelist and mirror it into the reconstructed request. I'll open PR and target 5% canary.
Eli: medium-term: emit a resume_fingerprint on quota events (hash of resume-token + client-id) so we can dedupe increments server-side within a configurable window.
Rhea: agree. add feature flag "quota.resume_dedupe" default off; when enabled, quota service ignores duplicates with same fingerprint within 20s.
OpsBot: canary 5% -> paused (errors +0) pending PR review.
ConsoleUI: dashboard ask: add card comparing "resume_requests" vs "new_sessions" by client_id and a ratio alert (threshold 1.03 for 10m). Also surface current sticky-ttl value in the UI debug drawer.
Jon: deployment plan: proxy header fix -> canary 5% -> monitor "resume_charges / unique_resume_fp". If ratio normalizes, ramp. If not, enable quota.resume_dedupe feature flag as mitigation.
Eli: also add an e2e flakey test that kills a stream, resumes, and asserts a single quota increment. This should run in the release pipeline for streaming changes.
Rhea: I'll draft the metric migration + dedupe algorithm doc. include how to backfill metrics for the next 48h and telemetry tags for sampled traces.
Jon: small UX note from ConsoleUI: when users inspect a session show last resume-token and attempts in the trace to simplify debugging.
Eli: ok assigned: Jon -> proxy header PR + e2e, Rhea -> quota dedupe + docs, ConsoleUI -> dashboard card + debug tooltip. Follow up in 6h and keep canary at 5% until we have stable numbers. :thumbsup:
